country.comment: The cached PDF contains only a trailing fragment of references and Supplemental Material Parts 1a-2b, which name 'Bushenyi-Ishaka' (PDF p. 1), 'NWSC' (PDF p. 2), and 'Bushenyi-Ishaka Municipality' (PDF p. 3), but never explicitly print the country name in the text; per strict blinding rules, country is not inferred from the citation header or municipality/utility names.
country.where_found: PDF p. 1, Supplemental Material Part 1a; PDF p. 3, Supplemental Material Part 1b

effect_estimate.comment: The cached PDF contains only blank data-collection questionnaires/interview guides (Supplemental Material Parts 1a and 1b, PDF pp. 1-13) and unpopulated section headings for Parts 2a and 2b (PDF pp. 14-15); the main article text and empirical results are absent.
effect_estimate.where_found: PDF pp. 1-15, Supplemental Material Parts 1a, 1b, 2a, and 2b

mechanism_certainty.comment: Cannot be determined because the cached PDF contains only Supplemental Material instruments and unpopulated headings without the main article's methods or empirical findings.

mechanism_flags.comment: In the Supplemental Material tracking instruments, Part 1b Question 7 explicitly tracks 'regulatory pressure' including 'Environmental law/standards enforcement, municipal by-laws enforcement' (PDF p. 10), Part 1a Indicators 4 and 12-13 track 'Compliance monitoring plan' (PDF p. 1) and 'Consumer complaint records kept' / 'Number of consumer complaints' (PDF p. 3), and Part 1a Indicators I.2 and W.10 track stakeholder WSP meetings and consumer satisfaction surveys (PDF pp. 2-3). Main-text analysis of these mechanisms is absent from the cached PDF.
mechanism_flags.where_found: PDF p. 1, Part 1a Indicator a.4; PDF pp. 2-3, Part 1a Indicators I.2, W.10, W.12-13; PDF p. 10, Part 1b Question 7

outcome_flags.comment: Supplemental Material Part 1a and Part 1b questionnaires explicitly track infrastructure 'new connections' (PDF p. 1, Indicator a.2), 'Supply continuity' in hours/day and >8-hour interruptions (PDF p. 2, Indicator W.1; PDF p. 4, Indicator m), and microbial, turbidity, chlorine residual, and pH 'Water quality compliance' (PDF p. 2, Indicators W.3-W.9; PDF p. 4, Indicator p). Main-text empirical results for these outcomes are missing from the cached PDF.
outcome_flags.where_found: PDF pp. 1-2, Supplemental Material Part 1a Indicators a.2, W.1, W.3-W.9; PDF p. 4, Part 1b Indicators m, p

publication_year.comment: No publication year for the paper is printed in the provided 15-page Supplemental Material PDF (the latest date printed in the text is an online reference access date of '9th July 2025' on PDF p. 1, alongside study period dates from July 2018 to March 2021 on PDF pp. 3, 14-15); per extraction rules, publication year is not copied from the blind-sheet citation header.
publication_year.where_found: PDF pp. 1-15 (checked throughout; latest reference access date on PDF p. 1)

risk_of_bias_tool.comment: Cannot determine the exact risk-of-bias tool because the cached PDF contains only Supplemental Material (a bi-monthly tracking questionnaire and a 3-monthly explanatory interview guide) without the main paper's methods section to verify whether the primary study is a mixed-methods evaluation (MMAT), longitudinal quasi-experimental/before-after analysis (ROBINS-I), or descriptive case study.

sample_size.comment: Not reported in the provided PDF, which includes only blank Supplemental Material questionnaires/interview guides (Parts 1a-1b) and empty section headers (Parts 2a-2b) without the main article text or sample counts.

study_design.comment: The main paper's methods section is missing from the cached PDF; the provided Supplemental Material shows a longitudinal Water Safety Plan (WSP) outcome and impact tracking design using a bi-monthly quantitative/operational tracking questionnaire (Part 1a) and a quarterly semi-structured explanatory interview guide (Part 1b, effective Aug. 2018), with outcome tracking windows spanning July 2018 to December 2019 (Part 2a) and January 2020 to March 2021 (Part 2b).
study_design.where_found: PDF p. 1, Part 1a; PDF p. 3, Part 1b; PDF pp. 14-15, Parts 2a-2b
